oracle.sql: INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline; WITH frames AS (SELECT upid, COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), CAST(surface_frame_token AS TEXT), CAST(display_frame_token AS TEXT), CAST(id AS TEXT)) AS frame_id FROM actual_frame_timeline_slice WHERE ts IS NOT NULL AND dur IS NOT NULL AND dur >= 0 GROUP BY upid, frame_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_frames, (SELECT start_ts FROM trace_bounds) AS start_ts, (SELECT end_ts FROM trace_bounds) AS end_ts FROM frames
